about: Rockstar's own GTA 6 page names Tommy Vercetti: in the Vintage Vice City Pack (a pre-order bonus marked for both Standard and Ultimate), the item 'Weapon Pattern' is titled 'Channel the Original Kingpin' and reads 'Adorn most guns with a tropical pattern inspired by Tommy Vercetti's iconic palm tree button-up.' (rockstargames.com/VI, plain curl 2026-11-02). Tommy's story was GTA Vice City (Steam listing of the Definitive Edition: 'Tommy Vercetti’s tale'), first released October 2002 on PS2 (Take-Two/Rockstar press release, 6 Dec 2012). The page never says Tommy is in GTA 6, and the film says so in the voice. The Ultimate-only 'Vercetti Estate' revolvers are left out (second scope; see BRIEF.md). Ends on a neutral yes/no that loops into line 1. GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Delta.
